newsitem.title: USA: NFL-FEW IN SUPER BOWL HAVE BEEN THERE BEFORE.
newsitem.headline: NFL-FEW IN SUPER BOWL HAVE BEEN THERE BEFORE.

text.p: Few Super Bowls in recent years have featured so many players who have never played for a National Football League championship.
When the Green Bay Packers and New England Patriots face off in Super Bowl XXXI on Sunday, just six players will take prior Super Bowl experience into the game -- four Patriots and two Packers.
The following is the list of players who have been through it before -- four of whom have been winners.
Quarterback Jim McMahon -- won Super Bowl XX as member of the Chicago Bears
Wide receiver Don Beebe -- lost Super Bowls XXV, XXVI, XXVII and XXVIII as member of Buffalo Bills
Offensive lineman William Roberts -- won Super Bowls XXI and XXV as member of New York Giants
Running back David Meggett -- won Super Bowl XXV as member of Giants
Offensive lineman Bob Kratch -- won Super Bowl XXV with Giants
Wide receiver Shawn Jefferson -- lost Super Bowl XXIX as member of San Diego Chargers.
